_comment: Single source of truth for the AgentCore Gateway Lambda MCP tool definitions. Read by stacks/gateway_stack.py (CfnGatewayTarget inlinePayload) and by the handler unit tests. Only the SchemaDefinition fields the Gateway accepts are used: type, description, properties, required, items. The reserved `__caller_token` property is present on every tool: the REQUEST interceptor overwrites it with the caller's verified bearer JWT, so any value the model supplies is discarded.

user-files.description: Per-user file storage in the OpenClaw user-files S3 bucket, scoped to the caller's namespace.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files stored for the current user. The user namespace is derived from the caller's identity; it cannot be chosen.

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file stored for the current user.

filename.description: File name (letters, digits, '_', '-', '.'; no path separators).

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 text file for the current user (max 1 MiB).

filename.description: File name (letters, digits, '_', '-', '.'; no path separators).

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file stored for the current user.

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.

schedules.description: EventBridge Scheduler reminders owned by the current user (openclaw-cron schedule group).

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a recurring or one-off schedule that sends a message to the current user. Expression: cron(6 fields), rate(N minutes|hours|days) with a 5-minute minimum, or at(YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

expression.description: EventBridge Scheduler expression, e.g. cron(0 9 * * ? *), rate(1 hour), at(2026-12-31T23:59:00).

message.description: The message to deliver when the schedule fires.

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.
Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.

tools.name: update_schedule
tools.description: Update one of the current user's schedules. Only the supplied fields change.

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete one of the current user's schedules.

__caller_token.description: Reserved. Set by the gateway from the caller's verified identity; any value supplied here is discarded.
